svg.text: Figure build study (#4176): male, female and three nonbinary options on the warrior, monk and ranger outfits. Build = shoulder, waist, hip width and one hair cue; team colour, badge, cape and weapon marks unchanged.
Nonbinary A: even build, side fringe. B: soft shoulders, narrow waist, bun. C: broad shoulders, narrow waist, short tail. Operator picks one (the pick goes in the .md).
